name: unityworld-hover
description: Hover on any string in JSON to get info from external CLI

unityworld-hover.cliPath.description: Path to the CLI executable that resolves hover info. Receives the hovered string as first argument, returns info via stdout.

unityworld-hover.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for CLI response.

unityworld-hover.useLongRunning.description: If true, use a long-running CLI process with stdin/stdout line protocol instead of spawning per hover.
